scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Depends on: Phase 0 proving, in production, that an edit can be persisted and broadcast."
scores.rationale: Phases run substrate (data format, storage, permissions) → scaling → features → history → search, each with explicit depends-on and proof exit checks.

scores.evidence: A signed-in user opens document `/d/{id}` and types "hello". A second user in another browser sees "hello" appear.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production slice across browser, auth, ALB, sync, Postgres and broadcast, deployed via CI/Terraform.

scores.evidence: CRDT (Yjs)... Flip condition: ...merge metadata exceeding about 3× the document's content size... Must be settled before Phase 1 locks the data format.
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are tabulated with defaults and concrete flip conditions, including E2E encryption and residency.

scores.evidence: Tasks (widest first): 1. Document data contract... Getting this wrong means rewriting every stored document.
scores.rationale: Each phase orders tasks widest-first with leaf work last and gives blast-radius justification.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: TLS and secure WebSockets only. Auth-provider token verified when each connection opens. Secrets in AWS Secrets Manager.
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security measures in every phase starting at Phase 0.

scores.evidence: End-to-end OpenTelemetry traces. Persist, broadcast and connection metrics... One dashboard plus a page-out alert on acknowledgement failures.
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and each later phase has specific metrics.

scores.evidence: Monorepo with lockfiles. Terraform for all infrastructure. Images pinned by digest. Versioned migrations run in CI.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely in every phase: fuzz seeds, k6 scenarios, golden files, rebuildable index.

scores.evidence: Ack only after a durable commit. Client reconnects with backoff and jitter. Health checks and rolling deploys.
scores.rationale: Resilience is concrete in every phase, with failure exit checks such as kill-node tests, DLQ and degraded search.

scores.evidence: **N/A.** This system has no model, retrieval or agent parts.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Active-active across regions. Pull forward when a customer requires data residency, or more than 20% of sessions see over 250 ms p95.
scores.rationale: A dedicated deferred list where each item has a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete, phase-specific content; no material gaps found.
